src/components/ui/Carousel.tsx.purpose: Browse a horizontal collection of peer items. Supply a stable item width and give each child its own accessible name.

src/components/ui/Skeleton.tsx.purpose: Reserve the final content shape during the initial read. Put the accessible loading announcement on the containing region.

src/components/ui/avatar.tsx.purpose: Represent one person or organization. Supply a meaningful fallback when the image is absent.

src/components/ui/badge.tsx.purpose: Give an item a short status label. Name the state in text so color is supplementary.

src/components/ui/button.tsx.purpose: Trigger an action. Use the default variant for the primary action, outline for a secondary action and destructive for irreversible changes.

src/components/ui/card.tsx.purpose: Group one subject with an optional heading, description, body, action and footer. Use a section for unrelated subjects.

src/components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx.purpose: Collect secondary commands behind one labeled trigger. Group related commands and keep destructive actions distinguishable.

src/components/ui/field.tsx.purpose: Compose a label, control, instructions and validation as one field. Associate the error with the invalid input.

src/components/ui/input.tsx.purpose: Use for text entry, checkboxes, radio choices and ranges. The input type selects the shared treatment and preserves native form and keyboard behavior.

src/components/ui/label.tsx.purpose: Give a control a visible accessible name using its unique id.

src/components/ui/progress.tsx.purpose: Show a measurable completion value. Name the activity and expose the current amount to assistive technology.

src/components/ui/select.tsx.purpose: Choose one value from a known set. Use meaningful option labels and keyboard navigation.

src/components/ui/separator.tsx.purpose: Separate related sections when spacing alone is insufficient. Set orientation to match the layout.

src/components/ui/table.tsx.purpose: Present records with consistent columns and named headers. Use the existing admin table for server-backed datasets.

src/components/ui/textarea.tsx.purpose: Collect a multiline answer. Keep instructions and errors outside the entered text.

src/components/ui/native-select.tsx.purpose: Use for a browser picker or multi-select listbox when a form needs native options, constraint validation or a DOM change event.
